name: Ripio wCOP
oneLiner: WCOP is Ripio's Colombian-peso wrapped fiat stablecoin, issued and redeemed through Ripio's wFIAT on/off-ramp infrastructure against local-currency reserves.
collateral: Colombian-peso cash and liquid local-currency instruments backing Ripio wCOP at a one Colombian peso target
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed local-currency stablecoin route targeting 1 WCOP = 1 COP through Ripio's wFIAT issuance, redemption, and on/off-ramp infrastructure

mintAuthority.summary: WCOP is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. Ethereum role logs resolve two current DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders plus three current MINTER_ROLE holders; non-Ethereum deployments remain unverified.

controls.label: Ripio shared WCOP admin and MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Ethereum role logs resolve this EOA as a current DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE holder. Signer policy was not decoded.

controls.label: WCOP secondary DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Ethereum role logs resolve this contract as a current DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder. Contract owner/policy was not decoded in the lane review.

controls.label: WCOP secondary Ethereum MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Ethereum role logs resolve this contract as a current MINTER_ROLE holder. Contract owner/policy was not decoded in the lane review.

controls.label: WCOP secondary Ethereum MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: Ethereum role logs resolve this contract as a current MINTER_ROLE holder. Contract owner/policy was not decoded in the lane review.

review.evidence: Review is scoped to Ethereum role-holder coverage: Ripio identifies WCOP as a wrapped local stablecoin, and the lane-2 role reconstruction resolves two current Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders and three current MINTER_ROLE holders.
unresolvedQuestions: Base, World Chain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis role holders and admins are not yet reconstructed.
Ethereum implementation source for 0x6f6206...6652 remains unresolved.
Policy/custody layer for the current Ethereum role holders and any per-chain equivalent admin remains unresolved.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ripio wCOP is centrally issued across multiple EVM chains; the public source confirms issuer-managed wFIAT mechanics but does not prove a holder-level blacklist path.

reserves.name: Colombian-peso cash and local-currency liquid instruments

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: COP is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so WCOP is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

notices.title: No per-token attestation located
notices.message: Ripio describes wFIAT local-currency backing, but no reliable public per-token reserve attestation was found for WCOP during this addition. Curated reserves remain conservative until source coverage improves.
